senses.gloss: m. Ar. (ed. גלא ק׳) (γαλῆ Ἀξεινῶν) [fur of] the weasel imported by the Axeinoi (living around the Pontus Axenus or Euxenus); ermine (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Pellis).

(rendition of <cite ref="V00388"><he>תַּחַשׁ</he></cite>) <cite ref="C00982"><he>גלקטינון</he></cite>; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 1:9">Koh. R. to I, 9</cite> <cite ref="C00925"><he>גלטינון</he></cite> (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 1:9:1">Ib.</cite> <he>והכלב גלבטינון</he> (read <he>גלכסינון</he>) and the dog shall wear ermine fur.
